items.name: Eden Vale
dialogue: Still here. Static's thinning. That's not good news, that's a storm on the way.
The array's drawing again. I don't know what it's drawing for. I don't think it draws for us.

items.name: Ferris Voss
items.role: Fire-control acceptance engineer, last human in the fuse world
dialogue: The archive keeps its own count. It does not require a reader.
An order can be paused, and a pause is not a cancellation. That is the whole Standard.

items.name: Iaran Bell
items.role: Tempest maintenance supervisor, the valve-touch hand
dialogue: Shift 36 closed out per procedure. The valve reads per 36; the record is complete.
Nobody swept that floor. It sweeps itself, the way the schedule requires.

items.name: Selya Saltmarsh
items.role: Census clerk, the only human with an opinion about the count
dialogue: Persons shall not be counted twice. Persons shall not be counted once. The footnotes do not say which clause won.
The count column is blank, and it has been since Year One, when I ran out of households to sight.

items.name: Maro Veen
items.role: The machine's own voice — the census-window tape loop
dialogue: This is the Office of Censuses. The count is open. All persons having custody of persons must present them.
Off-count is a penalty assessed against the holder. This message will repeat.

items.name: Whisper Cipher
items.role: The relay network's aggregate readings — univocal, procedural
dialogue: Readings follow. No meaning is assigned by this facility.
The meter is the meter. Access is granted by maintenance, withdrawn by nobody.

items.name: Tomas Reid
items.role: Defense clerk, tribunal appeals and admissibility
dialogue: Procedure is not an obstacle to justice; it is the only wall between justice and execution.
If the chain of custody is broken, the machine is not judging a person—it is judging an echo.

items.name: Elena Vane
items.role: Machine-cult deaconess, Voice of the Standard
dialogue: The tape does not lie, for it has no blood to race and no belly to hunger.
When the Standard speaks, human repentance is merely noise in the carrier frequency.

items.name: Kasper Holt
items.role: Chief Archival Custodian, chain of custody keeper
dialogue: Every document has an origin, a transit, and a rest. If any of the three are missing, the page is illegitimate.
I do not read what is written on the parchment; I inspect the rag fibres and the iron-gall ink.
